name: Chietino Table Lamp
desc: A modern table lamp featuring a geometric natural-wood tripod-style base and a cylindrical fabric drum shade. The open-frame wooden structure gives the fixture a light architectural appearance, while the fabric shade produces a soft warm glow suitable for sideboards, bedside tables, living rooms, and contemporary interiors.

specifications.Light Distribution: Soft ambient illumination with upward and downward spill
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 520 mm overall height x 300 mm shade diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Sideboard / Bedside table / Living room / Bedroom / Lounge / Console table
